items.title: Teardrop Damask Slat DXF Panel for CNC Gates
items.description: A tall, teardrop-shaped damask medallion runs down the panel's inner edge, built from nested scroll and lattice motifs, while wide horizontal slats fill the rest of the space. The asymmetrical placement of the medallion against the open slats gives this piece a modern twist on a traditional damask theme.

items.title: Interlocking Chevron Line DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Screens
items.description: Free for CNC and laser use, tightly packed horizontal lines bend into interlocking hexagonal chevron shapes across the entire panel, creating a rippling optical texture. The fine line spacing gives this design a woven, almost basket-like appearance from a distance.
